name: Youngone Corporation
summary: Youngone Corporation engages in the manufacture and sale of clothing, shoes, and supplies market worldwide. The company offers technical outdoor clothing and sportswear, knitwear, sweaters, and casual wear; sports, casual, sneakers, winter boots, military boots, and safety boots; and hiking, travel, casual, and business bags, as well as camping supplies. In addition, it produces nylon and polyester products. Youngone Corporation was founded in 1974 and is based in Seoul, South Korea. Youngone Corporation is a subsidiary of Youngone Holdings Co., Ltd.
